khromalabs_ataria_crypto_tradingworkbook.description: Manages a trading workbook: the persistent watchlist where every tracked coin carries its thesis through a lifecycle (WATCH -> PENDING_LIMIT -> HOLD -> removed). Writes are validated and fail closed: one entry per coin, 'add' requires a complete thesis (entry_type, direction and an invalidation rationale), and the workbook enforces a hard capacity cap.

parameters.description: The action to execute. Requires coin_id (except 'list'). 'add': add a new entry; requires 'coin_id', 'entry_type', 'direction' and 'invalidation' — the call fails without them. 'update': modify an existing entry; requires 'coin_id', accepts partial fields (only what's changing). 'delete': remove an entry; requires 'coin_id'. 'list': view the current workbook; no params required. Prefer entry_trigger_kind/level and expiry_hours over prose triggers: the deterministic Guardian only enforces the structured fields.
parameters.name: action

parameters.description: The plain coin symbol (e.g., 'btc', 'sol') or a list of symbols. Use the coin symbol ONLY — never trading pairs (not 'BTC/USDC') or market modifiers (not 'BTC/USDC:USDC'). Required for add, update, and delete.
parameters.name: coin_id

parameters.description: Trade direction: 'LONG' or 'SHORT'. Required for 'add'.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Optional. Machine-readable entry (upgrade) trigger for this setup, evaluated FORWARD from creation: 'cross_below' or 'cross_above'. Use instead of prose like 'place the limit only once price trades below X first' — the deterministic Guardian enforces this field.
parameters.name: entry_trigger_kind

parameters.description: Price level for entry_trigger_kind. Required together with entry_trigger_kind. The entry agent must place the resting limit only after this cross has occurred after evaluated_from_ts (forward semantics, not latched).
parameters.name: entry_trigger_level

parameters.description: REQUIRED for 'add'. Entry lifecycle type, must be one of: 'WATCH' (monitoring), 'PENDING_LIMIT' (limit order placed), or 'HOLD' (position open). This parameter is mandatory — the call will fail if omitted.
parameters.name: entry_type

parameters.description: Optional. Cancel the pending limit order if unfilled after this many hours from now (e.g. 24). Guardian enforces this deterministically.

Hard cap 500 chars; trade history and long narratives belong in the trading log, not here. Do NOT embed order ids or machine-actionable levels in notes: order links and triggers have dedicated structured fields.

user_crypto_eventscanner.description:
Deterministic news/event collector for the Sentinel event-driven
    strategy. Collects, normalizes and dedups event candidates from a
    declarative source registry into the persistent event ledger;
    applies validator verdicts through a write-guard; ranks actionable
    events for the act phase. Never trades.

parameters.description:
The action to execute. Allowed values:
- 'collect': fetch all enabled sources, dedup and write candidate events to the ledger. Returns the validator work queue ('pending_validation'), open-event reference ('open_events') and per-source health. Never trades.
- 'apply_validation': apply validator verdicts deterministically. Each verdict: {event_id, decision: confirm|reject|merge|postpone, resolved: {coin, event_class, event_date, direction, durability}, evidence_snippet (verbatim from the attestations — fabricated snippets fail), target_event_id (merge only), reason (reject only)}.
- 'select': rank confirmed events inside their class action window (deterministic; same-coin veto vs the workbook). Output feeds the regime probe/gate and the entry analyst. Never scans the web.
- 'regime_gate': deterministic stop-hostility gate (§7.7, strict removal). Takes the select result ('selected') plus the analysis skill's per-coin regime probe assessments ('assessments', keyed by coin). Hard-severity coins are removed into 'deferred_stop_hostile' and disclosed; warning passes annotated; unavailable metrics pass ungated + disclosed. Run-local decision — demoted events are re-selected and re-probed on the next run while their action window stays open. Never trades.
 Consuming agents must never act on 'deferred_stop_hostile' coins (deterministically gated; re-probed on the next run).
- 'mark_acted_on': mark an event acted_on after an entry was placed. Requires event_id and workbook_entry_ref (the key of the workbook entry just written). Write-guarded: only confirmed/watch events, only with a real workbook
parameters.name: action

parameters.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) override for 'collect' expiry sweep and 'select' window evaluation. Defaults to today (UTC).
parameters.name: as_of

parameters.description: Per-coin stop-hostility assessments from the analysis skill's regime probe (keyed by coin id). Required for action='regime_gate'.
parameters.name: assessments
parameters.type: object mapping string to object mapping string to any

parameters.description: Entry gate for action='select', echoed into the result as entries_disabled for the plan's avoid_step_if guard (the framework then skips the entry-analyst step entirely). Accepts the plan's micro_notional_usd dial verbatim: negative → entries disabled (scan-only), otherwise enabled. Booleans are also accepted.
parameters.name: entries_enabled

parameters.description: One-line decision summary stored with the acted_on stamp (optional).
parameters.name: event_decision

parameters.description: Ledger event id. Required for action='mark_acted_on'.
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.description: Ranked selected events (the 'select' result's 'selected' list). Required for action='regime_gate'.
parameters.name: selected
parameters.type: list of object mapping string to any

parameters.description: Validator verdicts. Required for action='apply_validation'.
parameters.name: verdicts

parameters.description: Key of the workbook entry just written (e.g. 'sol/usdc'). Required for action='mark_acted_on'.

parameters.description:
The action to execute. Allowed values:
- 'sentinel': Fully deterministic doctrine executor. Evaluates all positions and orders against the Sentinel Protection Doctrine rules and executes closes/cancellations without LLM involvement.
- 'curate': Deterministic workbook curation. Consumes the screener's structured 'curated_view' and applies removal, update (thesis flips, invalidation refresh) and addition rules without LLM involvement.

Candidates deeper than this are never added; existing WATCH entries are never deleted on hostility alone and deep ones are evicted first when trimming for capacity. Default 30 (i.e. margin deeper than -30%). Sentinel plans normally bind this from the shared screener property stop_hostility.deep_gate_margin_pct (market_analysis config alias) so the whole doctrine shares one value.

user_shopping_mercadona.description:
Searches Mercadona (Spanish supermarket) and builds the shopping cart;
    the cart is left saved for MANUAL checkout in Mercadona's official
    app/web — payment is never automated. Actions: search=text search
    (query, limit), batch_search=ONE call for a whole shopping list, e.g.
    when the user names several products (queries=[...], limit; returns
    groups aligned to queries), product=full detail (product_id),
    alternatives=cheaper products per reference unit, same category and
    format (product_id, limit), cart_get/cart_summary=current priced cart
    with budget state, cart_add=increment quantities in one batch
    (items=[{product_id, quantity}], max_eur optional), cart_set=set
    absolute quantities, 0 removes (items, max_eur), cart_clear=empty the
    cart (max_eur), set_limit=set the standing spending cap in EUR
    (max_eur; per-call max_eur can only be stricter than it),
    whoami=account and session info, history=local record of groceries
    bought (delivered orders, aggregates, most-bought products),
    history_sync=pull delivered orders from Mercadona into the local
    purchase record (idempotent). Every cart write enforces a hard
    spending cap (standing [limits] max_eur, per-call max_eur only
    tightens it) and fails closed if the total can't be verified.

parameters.description: One of: search | batch_search | alternatives | product | cart_get | cart_add | cart_set | cart_clear | cart_summary | set_limit | whoami | history | history_sync
parameters.name: action

parameters.description: batch of cart lines for cart_add/cart_set: [{"product_id": "4740", "quantity": 2}, ...]
parameters.name: items
parameters.type: list of object mapping string to any

parameters.description: max results for search/alternatives; purchases shown for history
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: per-call spending cap in EUR for cart writes; defaults to the [limits] max_eur in ~/.mercadona/config.toml
parameters.name: max_eur

parameters.description: product id for alternatives/product
parameters.name: product_id
